title: NESO (National Grid ESO) Carbon Intensity API response
description: External schema for optional NESO ingest. Base URL https://api.carbonintensity.org.uk. Unit in source: gCO2/kWh, generation-only, 30-minute settlement periods. License CC BY 4.0. Not a live experimental source (REPRO-01).

from.description: Interval start UTC, ISO-8601 compact form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ.

to.description: Interval end UTC (exclusive of next period).

actual.description: Estimated actual gCO2/kWh. May be null for future periods; may be revised after the fact.
